# Ideas to develop on

## Ideas for maximizing the Hourly Rates at Night
* The "Soft Cap": Change the Night Special to a 3-hour limit, after which the $9.00/hour rate kicks back in.
* Peak Night Filtering: Disable the Night Special on Friday and Saturday nights while keeping it for "slow" nights to keep the room looking full.
* The "Member Only" Perk: Use your SLATE software to make the $30.00 flat rate a "Pro Member" only benefit, while regular walk-ins pay the hourly rate.

* Customers, you can do the day rate or the night rate, but if are staying from day to night, you can't just have one rate.
